records.title: 外国人入境卡：官方免费渠道

assertion.zh: 如需填写外国人入境卡，可在国家移民管理局官方渠道免费填报；无法提前网办时，可在口岸用现场设备或填写纸质卡。
assertion.en: Where a foreign arrival card is required, use the free NIA channel. If advance online completion is unavailable, use port facilities or a paper card.

conditions: Only travelers required to complete the foreign arrival card; exemptions require individual verification.
Online service introduced2025-11-20; no sunset specified in this notice.
notClaimed: Not a visa, visa-free eligibility decision or guarantee of admission.
No claim that online completion is the only permitted route.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 外卡刷卡：先核受理标识

assertion.zh: 刷境外银行卡前，先看商户是否有相应卡组织受理标识；没有标识时，向收银员确认。
assertion.en: Check that a merchant accepts your card network before paying. If no acceptance logo is displayed, ask the cashier.

conditions: The specific card, issuer and merchant must support the transaction.
notClaimed: No universal merchant acceptance, fee, FX-rate or successful-payment guarantee.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 移动支付：注册、绑卡与扫码

assertion.zh: 可按支付宝或微信支付应用提示注册、绑定受支持银行卡，再扫描兼容商家码或出示付款码。
assertion.en: Follow Alipay or Weixin Pay prompts to register and link a supported card, then scan a compatible merchant code or show your payment code.

evidence.locator: 印刷页04–09（PDF第5–10页）；印刷页13条码产品提示

conditions: Card support, issuer verification and app terms apply at transaction time.
notClaimed: No fixed200-yuan fee threshold, fee-free guarantee, payment limit or personal-transfer support.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 人民币现金：ATM与兑换

assertion.zh: 需要人民币现金时，可选支持国际卡的ATM取现，或到有兑换标识的机构兑换外币。
assertion.en: Obtain RMB cash from an ATM accepting international cards or an exchange outlet displaying a currency-exchange sign.

conditions: Confirm available services, opening hours and charges with the particular operator.
notClaimed: No guarantee every ATM/hotel provides exchange; no rate or cash-import allowance advice.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 中国运营商SIM卡申请

assertion.zh: 申请中国运营商SIM卡，可带护照或外国人永久居留身份证到中国电信、中国移动或中国联通营业厅；网点办理能力、手机兼容和套餐需向运营商确认。
assertion.en: For a Chinese carrier SIM, take your passport or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card to a China Telecom, China Mobile or China Unicom outlet. Confirm branch capability, handset compatibility and plan details.

evidence.locator: 一、业务介绍；二、机卡准备；六、问题1–3（仅地区性补充）

conditions: National baseline comes from N-S03; N-S10 is corroborative local guidance, not a nationwide device rule.
notClaimed: No guarantee of eSIM availability, unrestricted internet, instant activation, all-branch service or a fixed tariff.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 线上身份核验未完成：到车站核验

assertion.zh: 12306线上身份核验未完成时，可持有效护照到铁路车站售票窗口办理身份核验。
assertion.en: If online identity verification is not completed, take a valid passport to a railway-station ticket office for identity verification.

conditions: Adult foreign-passport scenario; exact current verification state and required documents must be checked with12306.
notClaimed: No promise of instant verification, ticket availability or that every pending state blocks all purchases.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 乘车证件与进站时间

assertion.zh: 乘车时携带购票所用有效证件原件；行程信息单不能作为车票。检票会在发车前停止，具体时间看车站公告。
assertion.en: Carry the original valid ID used for the booking; an itinerary sheet is not a ticket. Ticket checks stop before departure at the time announced by the station.

evidence.locator: VI.Transportation / (I)Train / Railway station entry/exit and train boarding

conditions: Domestic railway e-ticket journey; follow the actual station, train and document-handling instructions.
notClaimed: No universal5/15/30-minute cutoff; no child-fare, refund/change or baggage-rule assertion.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 酒店办理外国客人住宿登记

assertion.zh: 外国人在旅馆住宿时，住宿登记由旅馆办理并报送所在地公安机关；入住时可向前台确认办理情况。
assertion.en: Hotels register foreign guests’ accommodation and report it to local public-security authorities. Ask reception to confirm the registration.

evidence.locator: Q1：出境入境管理法第39条的旅馆责任

conditions: Foreign guest staying in a hotel; administrative duty does not prove an individual property complied.
notClaimed: No inventory, acceptance or compliance guarantee for a named hotel; no claim that registration grants lawful stay.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 非酒店住所首次住宿登记

assertion.zh: 在旅馆以外住所首次住宿，应在入住后24小时内由本人或留宿人向住所地公安机关办理住宿登记；线上渠道与再次入住的简化条件另核。
assertion.en: For a first stay at a non-hotel address, you or your host must register with local public-security authorities within 24 hours of arrival. Check online channels and repeat-stay exceptions separately.

evidence.locator: 央视记者试点范围问答

conditions: First registration at the current non-hotel address; repeat-stay exceptions are outside this concise assertion.
The examined NIA national online pilot names seven regions including Chongqing; do not infer the same NIA service is operational in Shanghai/Beijing/Guangzhou.
Other local online services may exist; this research did not test submission.
notClaimed: No nationwide-online claim, guaranteed registration acceptance or personal legal-status assessment.
records.recheck: Before user-facing release/use; sooner if authority or operational notices change

records.title: 大陆紧急号码

assertion.zh: 中国大陆：报警110、火警119、急救120。
assertion.en: Mainland China emergency numbers: police 110, fire 119 and ambulance 120.

conditions: Mainland scope only, including the four selected cities; Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan are excluded.
notClaimed: No diagnosis, treatment, clinical triage, English availability, no-SIM/roaming connectivity, free ambulance or response-time guarantee.
